transforms: RGB plus separated Alpha texture merge
atlas texture dimensions normalized and pma: true recorded

limitations: Native executable code is unavailable; recovered source actions and literal Spine events establish bounded behavior, not frame parity.
Total stored traps combine the native ready card with stacked cards; equal-frame contacts use nearest centre then spawn order.
Trap ATK is sampled from the owner at placement; native attribute-transfer phase is not recovered.
Trap impact applies control before damage. The device remains through its owned control buff, then dismisses; exact native dispatch ordering is not recovered.
S2 burst locks the triggering victim and replaces unfinished bursts. Native simultaneous marker ordering and attack-CD reset internals are not recovered.
Host shot damage samples live owner ATK at projectile impact; native attack-snapshot phase is not recovered. Fired projectiles survive interruption; unreleased shots cancel.
Original skeletons and hit events are retained; Unity effects, audio and module behavior are not reproduced.
